enrichment method: Flag affinity resins with or without Flag-tagged MFN2 coating (MFN2-beads) were incubated with cell lysates at 4°C overnight.
labeling: The eluted protein samples were subjected to SDS-PAGE or MS analysis.
reduction reagent: The protein was eluted with lysis buffer containing 1 mmol/L dithiothreitol (DTT; Gibco), 0.1% DDM, and 400 μg/mL Flag peptide.
reduction concentration: The protein was eluted with lysis buffer containing 1 mmol/L dithiothreitol (DTT; Gibco), 0.1% DDM, and 400 μg/mL Flag peptide.
